metrics.evidence: the CMDC uses a balanced discretionary approach to assess performance against four broad categories: I. Business Results
II. Risk, Controls & Conduct, including feedback received from the Firm's risk and control professionals
III. Client/Customer/Stakeholder Focus, including our engagement in communities
IV. Teamwork & Leadership, including creating a diverse and inclusive environment that encourages employees to speak up
the ultimate number of PSUs paid out at vesting is determined by a formula based on absolute and relative ROTCE performance, with the value of the payout ranging from 0% to 150%
Payout by relative ROTCE Scale 1st Quartile 150% 2nd Quartile 100% to 125% 3rd Quartile 70% to 100% 4th Quartile 25% to 55%

metrics.metric: Common equity Tier 1 capital ratio minimum hurdle
metrics.evidence: If the Firm's common equity Tier 1 ("CET1") capital ratio is less than 7.5% at any year-end, then unvested PSUs referencing that performance year will be subject to downward adjustment by the CMDC

metrics.metric: Absolute ROTCE goal for 2018 PSU award calibrated to 18%
metrics.evidence: For the 2018 PSU award granted in January 2019, the Committee calibrated the Absolute ROTCE goal to 18% based on the current forecast of the Firm's future performance
